messages:
amira: Heads up — console quota sparklines are going blank for a subset of tenants after yesterday's telemetry change. Anyone seen this?

tom_g: saw the same in prod for 2 tenants around 10:20 UTC. Only happens when viewing 1h and 6h windows. :thinking_face:

kevin_zh: same here, flagging it now. Could be sampling mismatch between events and aggregates. @alisa_pm any recent API changes?

alisa_pm: Console side didn't change. Telemetry team noted they switched to event-level sampling + removed the old /aggregates endpoint last week (was behind a feature flag). I thought we coordinated the deprec.

deploy-bot: deploybot: telemetry-sampler v3 rolled to region-us-west at 2026-03-20T12:03:00Z (canary -> prod).

amira: Frontend expects /aggregates/v1/usage?sparkline=true and a compact timeseries array. New /events/summary returns counts + sampling_rate, different shape. Frontend code errors on undefined.series.

tom_g: two options I see: 1) update SDK telemetry collector to synthesize the sparkline series client-side (fast patch), or 2) restore a server-side aggregate shim that returns the old shape.

kevin_zh: client-side synthesis duplicates logic across py/ts/go — maintenance burden. But server shim might be heavier on CPU if we compute aggregates on the fly. Need to measure cost.

alisa_pm: PM perspective: prefer single source (server-side) to avoid divergence. But we can do a short-lived shim while we design a better aggregate API.

amira: Agreed on shim for short-term. @tom_g who owns the proxy/edge where we can put a shim?

tom_g: eng-infra owns proxy. I can open an infra ticket and spike perf impact. Quick plan: proxy returns legacy shape by transforming /events/summary -> aggregates array for the requested window. Canary 10% -> 100% if perf OK.

kevin_zh: sounds reasonable. SDKs should add a defensive fallback in next minor: warn if aggregates absent and fallback to synthesized series. Add a telemetry opt-in flag so customers can control extra calls.

alisa_pm: rollout plan: shim hotfix within 24h canary → full if no regressions. SDKs: add fallback + deprecation log in 1.2.0, announce in release notes.

amira: I'll post a short repro in #help and attach the failing console stack trace. For the record, console error: 

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'series' of undefined
 at renderSparkline (dashboard.js:1234)
 at renderQuotaTile (dashboard.js:987)
```

tom_g: opening infra ticket now and will link here. If anyone can run quick perf bench against sample 100k events -> aggregate transform, that will help scope CPU impact.

kevin_zh: I'll run a quick local bench and paste numbers in here in ~30m.

alisa_pm: thx all — also please mention this in the morning standup so CS doesn't get hit by support noise. :eyes:
